issue.message: Imports and reads entity store directly (useDashboardStore from @app/entities/dashboard/store) instead of using entity layer hooks/functions. Fix: Remove import of useDashboardStore/store inner file. Read existing dashboards via the entity hook (e.g. useListDashboards) called unconditionally before any early return, and derive the unique 'Untitled Dashboard' name from its data.

entries.reason: Removed direct store import; now calls useListDashboards unconditionally before early return and derives unique name from its data.
